|notes=Tooex is a cheap Light droid (deploy 2, forfeit 2) whose job is to stand at a planet site after dark and pump your Rebels and aliens.

The power +2 applies to each of your Rebels and aliens at the '''same planet site''' as Tooex, but only while Tooex is '''present''' under [[nighttime conditions]]. Immunity to attrition &lt; 3 is a second check: nighttime '''and''' a [[Hydroponics Station]] present with Tooex. Tooex itself is a droid, so it does not get the Rebel/alien bonus.

Typical home is a Tatooine exterior site at night (Lars farm, Jawa Camp, Dune Sea) with [[Nightfall]] in play. The Dark Side copy [[2X-7KPR (Tooex)]] (Special Edition) is the Imperial mirror and does not need Hydroponics Station for the immunity.

The name 2X-3KPR (Tooex) originates on this Premiere card. Wookieepedia treats it as the Legends identification of the Lars homestead perimeter droid from ''A New Hope''.
